 Make Holiday Shopping More Exciting with Exclusive HONOR Deals at TikTok Shop’s Super Brand Festival 
 by Josh Austria 
 November 20, 2026 
 Josh Austria 
 Aside from being a businessman, Josh Austria has been working…
 Enjoy special offers on HONOR smartphones and tablets, plus 0% interest installments for up to six months. 
 Global AI device provider HONOR Philippines is joining the TikTok Shop Super Brand Festival from November 19 to 25, giving Filipino shoppers access to exclusive deals, freebies, and flexible payment options on select HONOR smartphones and tablets.
 With the holiday season approaching, shoppers can explore a range of HONOR devices for their everyday needs or as gifts for family and friends. The week-long sale features special offers on the HONOR Pad X9b Max, HONOR Pad X7b, HONOR Play 20A, HONOR 600 5G, HONOR X9d 5G, and HONOR X5c Plus.
 Enjoy Exclusive Offers on HONOR Devices 
 The Super Brand Festival brings discounts of up to PHP 6,000 on select HONOR smartphones and tablets, giving shoppers more choices for themselves or their loved ones this holiday season. The HONOR Pad X9b Max, available with up to PHP 3,000 off, while the HONOR Pad X7b offered exclusively on TikTok Shop. The newly launched HONOR Play 20A, also included in the sale, giving customers another smartphone option to consider.
 Moreover, those who purchase the HONOR 600 5G, HONOR X9d 5G, or HONOR X5c Plus will receive a free HONOR Gift Bluetooth Speaker II worth PHP 1,299. They can enjoy 0% interest installments for up to six months through TikTok PayLater or Metrobank Credit Cards, subject to applicable terms and conditions.
 HONOR will also offer exclusive deals and special prices during its TikTok livestreams throughout the Super Brand Festival. Visit the HONOR Official TikTok Shop from November 19 to 25 to explore the latest offers and enjoy limited time deals this holiday season.
 For further information about HONOR Philippines, you may visit: https://www.honor.com/ph/ . To stay updated on launch announcements, product information, and exclusive offers, follow HONOR Philippines’ social media platforms on Facebook (Facebook.com/ HonorPhilippines), Instagram (Instagram.com/honorph/) and TikTok : (Tiktok.com/@honorphilippines) for exclusive launch updates, product information, and more. #SuperBrandFestival #HONORPhilippines
